extra.h005_action: When proposing the trial, state explicitly what the record is for — joint review, rewriting lines, open fairness checks — and what it is not for: collecting private evidence.
extra.h005_consequence: Dissolves most of the ledger-versus-score-keeping tension along the lines the objection itself suggests, and gives the absorb-versus-raise question a terminus that is a venue rather than a threshold, so tolerance does not need a tripwire.
